title: Recursive pass — WEF Data Equity 2024 roster continuity depth 4
summary: Compared the 2023 and 2024 council rosters, resolved continuity and turnover, preserved role transitions, and selected bounded Palantir-network closure as depth 5.

sources.title: Advancing Data Equity:An Action-Oriented Framework PDF
WEF Advancing Data Equity 2024 mirrored full text

data.research_question: What changed in the council network between the 2023 and 2024 Data Equity outputs?
data.method: Compare report-dated contributor rosters and retain affiliation changes as temporal observations.
classification_rules: A recurring name establishes roster continuity only for the named reports.
Changed role labels are temporal facts and do not overwrite older publication-era affiliations.
Named employee participation does not become an employer-level authorship or control edge.

findings.finding: Eighteen of nineteen 2023 council members recur in the 2024 report contributor roster.
Hsiao remains explicitly Palantir-affiliated in the 2024 contributor roster.
Busetto's organization changes from Adecco Group to HealthAI across the report pair, demonstrating why role timing must remain versioned.
